"""Paged listings over the in-memory store used by the demo server."""


def list_users(store, page=1, per_page=20):
    items = sorted(store.get("users", {}).values(), key=lambda item: item["id"])
    start = (page - 1) * per_page
    chunk = items[start:start + per_page]
    return {
        "kind": "users",
        "items": chunk,
        "page": page,
        "total": len(items),
        "has_more": start + per_page < len(items),
    }
